title.en: Reading: Schools and Institutes of Learning

intro.en: Two reading passages about how the mosque, the kuttab and the old schools taught Muslims, including the famous Al-Azhar mosque, followed by comprehension and vocabulary exercises. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do parhne ke tukde hain ke masjid, kuttab aur purane madaaris mein musalmanon ko kaise parhaya jata tha, aur mashhoor Al-Azhar ka zikr bhi hai. Phir samajh aur alfaz ki mashqein hain. Ek ek jumla aaram se parhein.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ عَنْ كَيْفَ عَلَّمَ المَسْجِدُ وَالكُتّابُ وَالمَدارِسُ القَديمَةُ المُسْلِمينَ، وَمِنْها جامِعُ الأَزْهَرِ المَشْهورُ، ثُمَّ تَمارينُ في الفَهْمِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: كانَ المَسْجِدُ في تاريخِنا أَوْسَعَ مِنْ مَكانٍ لِلصَّلاةِ؛ فَقَدْ كانَ مَدْرَسَةً يَجْلِسُ فيها الطُّلّابُ لِيَتَعَلَّموا القُرْآنَ وَالقِراءَةَ وَالكِتابَة.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-masjidu fī tārīkhinā awsaʿa min makānin li-ṣ-ṣalāt; fa-qad kāna madrasatan yajlisu fīhā ṭ-ṭullābu li-yataʿallamū l-qurʾāna wa l-qirāʾata wa l-kitāba.
dialogue.en: In our history the mosque was wider than a place of prayer; it was a school where students sat to learn the Quran, reading and writing.
dialogue.ur: Hamari tareekh mein masjid sirf namaz ki jagah nahi thi; woh ek madrasa thi jahan talba Quran, parhna aur likhna seekhne baithte the.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ زادَ عَدَدُ الطُّلّابِ أُنْشِئَ الكُتّابُ قُرْبَ المَسْجِدِ، فَتَعَلَّمَ الصِّغارُ فيهِ مَبادِئَ القِراءَةِ وَالكِتابَةِ وَحِفْظَ القُرْآن.
dialogue.tr: wa ḥīna zāda ʿadadu ṭ-ṭullābi unshiʾa l-kuttābu qurba l-masjid, fa-taʿallama ṣ-ṣighāru fīhi mabādiʾa l-qirāʾati wa l-kitābati wa ḥifẓa l-qurʾān.
dialogue.en: When the number of students grew, the kuttab was set up near the mosque, and children learned in it the basics of reading, writing and memorising the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Jab talba ki tadad barhi to masjid ke qareeb kuttab qayam hua, jis mein bachche parhne, likhne aur Quran yaad karne ki bunyadi baatein seekhte the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الكُتّابُ يُشْبِهُ مَدْرَسَةَ الأَطْفالِ اليَوْمَ، وَيَضُمُّ أَعْداداً كَبيرَةً مِنَ التَّلاميذ.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna l-kuttābu yushbihu madrasata l-aṭfāli l-yawm, wa yaḍummu aʿdādn kabīratan mina t-talāmīdh.
dialogue.en: The kuttab resembled the children's school of today and held large numbers of pupils.
dialogue.ur: Kuttab aaj ke bachchon ke school jaisa tha aur us mein shagirdon ki bari tadad hoti thi.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ ظَهَرَتِ المَدارِسُ الكُبْرى لِمَنْ أَرادَ التَّوَسُّعَ في العِلْمِ، وَكانَتِ الدِّراسَةُ فيها مَجّاناً؛ فَلا يَدْفَعُ الفَقيرُ وَلا الغَنِيُّ شَيْئاً.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda dhālika ẓaharati l-madārisu l-kubrā liman arāda t-tawassuʿa fī l-ʿilm, wa kānati d-dirāsatu fīhā majjānn; fa-lā yadfaʿu l-faqīru wa lā l-ghaniyyu shayʾn.
dialogue.en: After that the great schools appeared for those who wanted to expand in knowledge, and study in them was free; neither the poor nor the rich paid anything.
dialogue.ur: Is ke baad bari madaris samne aayin un ke liye jo ilm mein wusat chahte the, aur un mein parhai muft thi; na gareeb kuch deta na ameer.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتِ الأَوْقافُ تُنْفِقُ عَلى المَدْرَسَةِ، فَمِنْها تُدْفَعُ رَواتِبُ الشُّيوخِ وَيُطْعَمُ الطُّلّاب.
dialogue.tr: wa kānati l-awqāfu tunfiqu ʿalā l-madrasat, fa-minhā tudfaʿu rawātibu sh-shuīūkhi wa yuṭʿamu ṭ-ṭullāb.
dialogue.en: Endowments (awqaf) spent on the school; from them the sheikhs' salaries were paid and the students were fed.
dialogue.ur: Awqaf madrase par kharch karte the; unhi se shuyookh ki tankhwahein di jati thin aur talba ko khana khilaya jata tha.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ لِلْغُرَباءِ سَكَنٌ داخِلَ المَدْرَسَةِ، أَمّا أَبْناءُ المَدينَةِ فَيَرْجِعونَ إِلى أُسَرِهِمْ مَساءً.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna li-l-ghurabāʾi sakanun dākhila l-madrasat, ammā abnāʾu l-madīnati fa-yarjiʿūna ilā usarihim masāʾan.
dialogue.en: Strangers had lodging inside the school, while the sons of the city went back to their families in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Pardesiyon ke liye madrase ke andar rehne ki jagah thi, jabke shehar ke bete shaam ko apne gharon ko laut jate the.

dialogue.ar: وَتَحْتَوي المَدْرَسَةُ عادَةً عَلى مَسْجِدٍ وَقاعاتٍ لِلدَّرْسِ وَمَكْتَبَةٍ يُطالِعُ فيها الطُّلّابُ الكُتُبَ، وَساحَةٍ يَجْلِسونَ فيها في الهَواءِ الطَّلْق.
dialogue.tr: wa taḥtawī l-madrasatu ʿādatan ʿalā masjidin wa qāʿātin li-d-darsi wa maktabatin yuṭāliʿu fīhā ṭ-ṭullābu l-kutub, wa sāḥatin yajlisūna fīhā fī l-hawāʾi ṭ-ṭalq.
dialogue.en: A school usually contained a mosque, lecture halls and a library where students read books, and a courtyard where they sat in the open air.
dialogue.ur: Madrase mein aam taur par masjid, dars ke kamre, ek kutub-khana jahan talba kitabein mutala karte, aur ek sehan hota jahan woh khuli hawa mein baithte.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ المَعاهِدِ المَشْهورَةِ جامِعُ الأَزْهَرِ في القاهِرَةِ، وَفيهِ حَلَقاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ يَجْلِسُ فيها الطُّلّابُ حَوْلَ شُيوخِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa mina l-maʿāhidi l-mashhūrati jāmiʿu l-azhari fī l-qāhirat, wa fīhi ḥalaqātun kathīratun yajlisu fīhā ṭ-ṭullābu ḥawla shuīūkhihim.
dialogue.en: Among the famous institutes is the Al-Azhar mosque in Cairo, where many circles are held in which students sit around their sheikhs.
dialogue.ur: Mashhoor idaron mein Qahira ki Jame Azhar hai, jis mein kai halqe hote hain jin mein talba apne shuyookh ke gird baithte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ لِلطُّلّابِ فيهِ أَرْوِقَةٌ يَسْكُنونَ فيها بِحَسَبِ بِلادِهِمْ، فَهٰذا رِواقٌ لِلْمَغارِبَةِ وَذاكَ رِواقٌ لِأَهْلِ الشّام.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna li-ṭ-ṭullābi fīhi arwiqatun yaskunūna fīhā bi-ḥasabi bi-lādihim, fa-hādhā riūqun li-l-maghāribati wa dhāka riūqun li-ahli sh-shām.
dialogue.en: The students there had arwiqa (residential halls) where they lived according to their lands; this is a riwaq for the Moroccans and that a riwaq for the people of Sham.
dialogue.ur: Wahan talba ke liye arwiqa the jin mein woh apne mulk ke hisab se rehte; yeh Maghribiyon ka riwaq hai aur woh Shaam walon ka.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَيُّ رَجُلٍ يَتَصَدَّرُ لِلتَّدْريسِ، بَلْ مَنْ أَجازَهُ شُيوخُهُ وَعَرَفوا عِلْمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa lam yakun ayyu rajulin yataṣaddaru li-t-tadrīs, bal man ajāzahu shuīūkhuhu wa ʿarafū ʿilmah.
dialogue.en: Not just any man would take the seat of teaching, but only one whom his sheikhs had authorised and whose knowledge they knew.
dialogue.ur: Har koi padhane nahi baithta tha, balke wohi jise us ke shuyookh ne ijazat di aur us ka ilm pehchana.

dialogue.ar: وَتَنَوَّعَتِ المَدارِسُ بِحَسَبِ العُلومِ: لِلْقُرْآنِ، وَلِلْحَديثِ، وَلِلطِّبِّ، وَلِلْأَيْتامِ، وَأَكْثَرُها كانَ لِلْفِقْه.
dialogue.tr: wa tanawwaʿati l-madārisu bi-ḥasabi l-ʿulūm: li-l-qurʾān, wa lilḥadīth, wa lilṭṭibb, wa lilʾaytām, wa aktharuhā kāna li-l-fiqh.
dialogue.en: Schools varied according to the sciences: for the Quran, for hadith, for medicine, for orphans, and most of them were for fiqh.
dialogue.ur: Madaris uloom ke hisab se mukhtalif thay: Quran ke liye, hadees ke liye, tibb ke liye, yatimon ke liye, aur un mein se aksar fiqh ke liye the.

dialogue.ar: فَما أَجْمَلَ الماضي حينَ كانَ العِلْمُ لِلْجَميعِ، وَما أَحْوَجَنا في الحاضِرِ إِلى أَنْ نَتَعَلَّمَ مِنْه.
dialogue.tr: fa-mā ajmala l-māḍī ḥīna kāna l-ʿilmu li-l-jamīʿ, wa mā aḥwajanā fī l-ḥāḍiri ilā an nataʿallama minh.
dialogue.en: How beautiful the past was when knowledge was for everyone, and how much we need in the present to learn from it.
dialogue.ur: Maazi kitna khoobsurat tha jab ilm sab ke liye tha, aur aaj hamein us se seekhne ki kitni zaroorat hai.

title.en: Grammar A: The defective noun (al-ism al-manqūṣ)

intro.en: A defective noun (مَنْقوص) ends in a ya (ـيِ) with a kasra before it, like القاضي (the judge). Its ya disappears when it has tanween in the nominative and genitive: قاضٍ. It stays in the accusative: قاضِياً. In the dual it stays: قاضِيان. In the sound masculine plural it drops: قاضُونَ / قاضِينَ.
intro.ur: Al-ism al-manqus woh lafz hai jis ke aakhir mein ya (ـيِ) ho aur uske pehle kasra ho, jaise القاضي (qazi). Raf aur jarr mein tanween ke saath ya gir jati hai: قاضٍ. Nasb mein ya rehti hai: قاضِياً. Tasniya mein ya rehti hai: قاضِيان. Jama muzakkar salim mein ya gir jati hai: قاضُونَ / قاضِينَ.
intro.ar: الِاسْمُ المَنْقوصُ هُوَ اسْمٌ مُعْرَبٌ آخِرُهُ ياءٌ لازِمَةٌ قَبْلَها كَسْرَةٌ مِثْلَ القاضي. تُحْذَفُ ياؤُهُ عِنْدَ التَّنْوينِ في الرَّفْعِ وَالجَرِّ: قاضٍ، وَتَثْبُتُ في النَّصْبِ: قاضِياً، وَتَثْبُتُ في المُثَنّى: قاضِيان، وَتُحْذَفُ في جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ: قاضُونَ وَقاضِينَ.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعَ النّاسُ المُنادِيَ في السّوقِ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿa n-nāsu l-munādiya fī s-sūq.
dialogue.en: The people heard the caller in the market.
dialogue.ur: Logon ne bazaar mein pukarne wale ko suna.

dialogue.tr: hādhā wādin jamīl.
dialogue.en: This is a beautiful valley.
dialogue.ur: Yeh ek khoobsurat wadi hai.

dialogue.ar: مَرَرْتُ بِقاضٍ عادِلٍ.
dialogue.tr: marartu bi-qāḍin ʿādil.
dialogue.en: I passed by a just judge.
dialogue.ur: Main ek adil qazi ke paas se guzra.

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ داعِياً إِلى الخَيْرِ.

dialogue.en: I saw a caller to good.
dialogue.ur: Maine bhalai ki taraf bulane wala dekha.

dialogue.tr: al-muṣalliīni yaqifāni fī ṣ-ṣaffi l-awwal.
dialogue.en: The two worshippers stand in the first row.
dialogue.ur: Dono namazi pehli saf mein khade hain.

dialogue.ar: الباقونَ في الفَصْلِ قَليلونَ.
dialogue.tr: al-bāqūna fī l-faṣli qalīlūn.
dialogue.en: Those who remain in the class are few.
dialogue.ur: Class mein baqi bachne wale thore hain.

title.en: Grammar B: The maqṣūr noun (ending in long alif)

intro.en: A maqṣūr noun ends in a long alif, like العَصا (the stick) or فَتىً (a youth). In the dual the alif becomes ya or waw: فَتَيان, عَصَوان. In the sound masculine plural the alif is dropped and a fatha stays: مُصْطَفَوْنَ. In the feminine plural the original letter returns: فَتَيات, عَصَوات.
intro.ur: Al-ism al-maqsur woh lafz hai jiske aakhir mein lambi alif ho, jaise العَصا (lathi) ya فَتىً (jawan). Tasniya mein alif ya ya waw ban jati hai: فَتَيان، عَصَوان. Jama muzakkar salim mein alif gir jati hai aur fatha rehta hai: مُصْطَفَوْنَ. Jama muannas salim mein asal harf wapas aata hai: فَتَيات، عَصَوات.
intro.ar: الِاسْمُ المَقْصورُ آخِرُهُ أَلِفٌ لازِمَةٌ مِثْلَ العَصا وَفَتىً. في المُثَنّى تَنْقَلِبُ الأَلِفُ ياءً أَوْ واواً: فَتَيان، عَصَوان. وَفي جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ تُحْذَفُ الأَلِفُ وَتَبْقى الفَتْحَةُ: مُصْطَفَوْنَ. وَفي جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ يَعودُ الحَرْفُ الأَصْلِيُّ: فَتَيات، عَصَوات.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ هٰذِهِ العَصا ثَقيلَةٌ عَلَيْكَ يا جَدّي؟
dialogue.tr: hal hādhihi l-ʿaṣā thaqīlatun ʿalayka yā jaddī?
dialogue.en: Is this stick heavy for you, grandfather?
dialogue.ur: Dada jaan, kya yeh lathi aap par bhaari hai?

dialogue.ar: الفَتى المُجْتَهِدُ مَحْبوبٌ بَيْنَ أَصْدِقائِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-fatā l-mujtahidu maḥbūbun bayna aṣdiqāʾih.
dialogue.en: The hard-working youth is loved among his friends.
dialogue.ur: Mehnati naujawan apne doston mein mehboob hota hai.

dialogue.ar: اِتَّبِعِ الهُدى تَنْجُ.
dialogue.tr: ittabiʿi l-hudā tanj.
dialogue.en: Follow the guidance and you will be saved.
dialogue.ur: Hidayat ki pairwi karo, nijat paoge.

dialogue.ar: سَمَّتْ مَرْيَمُ ابْنَتَها نُهى.
dialogue.tr: sammat maryamu bnatahā nuhā.
dialogue.en: Maryam named her daughter Nuha.
dialogue.ur: Maryam ne apni beti ka naam Nuha rakha.

dialogue.ar: زُرْتُ المُسْتَشْفى هٰذا الصَّباحَ لِأَعودَ صَديقي.
dialogue.tr: zurtu l-mustashfā hādhā ṣ-ṣabāḥa li-aʿūda ṣadīqī.
dialogue.en: I visited the hospital this morning to see my friend.
dialogue.ur: Main aaj subah apne dost ki iyadat ke liye aspatal gaya.

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ فَتَيَيْنِ يَلْعَبانِ في الحَديقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: raʾaytu fa-tayayni yalʿabāni fī l-ḥadīqat.
dialogue.en: I saw two youths playing in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Maine do naujawanon ko baagh mein khelte dekha.

dialogue.ar: المُصْطَفَوْنَ لِلْمُسابَقَةِ أَرْبَعَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-muṣṭafawna li-l-musābaqati arbaʿat.
dialogue.en: Those chosen for the competition are four.
dialogue.ur: Muqabale ke liye chune gaye log chaar hain.

dialogue.ar: في المَدينَةِ مُسْتَشْفَياتٌ كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-madīnati mustashfayātun kathīrat.
dialogue.en: In the city there are many hospitals.
dialogue.ur: Shehar mein bohat se aspatal hain.

q.en: Which word is a maqṣūr noun (ends in long alif)?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz maqsur hai (lambi alif par khatam)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمٌ مَقْصورٌ (آخِرُهُ أَلِفٌ لازِمَةٌ)؟

q.en: What is the dual of «فَتىً»?
q.ur: «فَتىً» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: What is the dual of «عَصا»?
q.ur: «عَصا» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: What does «المُسْتَشْفى» mean?
q.ur: «المُسْتَشْفى» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What happens to the alif in the sound masculine plural, like مُصْطَفَوْنَ?
q.ur: مُصْطَفَوْنَ jaise jama muzakkar salim mein alif ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِلْأَلِفِ في جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ مِثْلَ مُصْطَفَوْنَ؟

options: It is dropped and a fatha stays

title.en: Extended reading: The story of Ibrahim
title.ur: Wasee mutala: Ibrahim (alaihis salam) ka qissa

intro.en: The story of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him): his call to his people and his father, how he broke the idols, how he was thrown into the fire and was saved, his talk with the king Namrud, the stars, and his migration to Makkah. Then comprehension and vocabulary exercises.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Nabi Ibrahim (alaihis salam) ka qissa hai: apni qaum aur walid ko daawat, butoun ko todna, aag mein daale jana aur bach jana, badshah Namrud se baat, sitaron ki bahes aur Makkah ki taraf hijrat. Phir samajh aur alfaz ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: قِصَّةُ النَّبِيِّ إِبْراهيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: دَعْوَتُهُ لِقَوْمِهِ وَأَبيهِ، وَتَحْطيمُهُ الأَصْنامَ، وَإِلْقاؤُهُ في النّارِ وَنَجاتُهُ، وَحِوارُهُ مَعَ المَلِكِ النُّمْرودِ، وَالكَواكِبُ، وَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلى مَكَّةَ. ثُمَّ تَمارينُ في الفَهْمِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ.

dialogue.ar: نَشَأَ إِبْراهيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ في بَيْتٍ وَبَلَدٍ يَعْبُدُ أَهْلُهُما الأَصْنامَ مِنَ الحِجارَةِ وَالأَوْثان.
dialogue.tr: nashaʾa ibrāhīmu ʿalayhi s-salāmu fī baytin wa baladin yaʿbudu ahluhumā l-aṣnāma mina l-ḥijārati wa l-awthān.
dialogue.en: Ibrahim, peace be upon him, grew up in a home and a land whose people worshipped idols of stone and statues.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim alaihis salam ek aise ghar aur shehar mein pale barhe jahan ke log pathar ke butoon aur but-parasti ke nishanon ko poojte the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ يَتَأَمَّلُ وَيُفَكِّرُ: كَيْفَ يَعْبُدُ الإِنْسانُ حَجَراً أَخْرَسَ لا يَنْطِقُ، أَعْمى لا يُبْصِرُ، أَصَمَّ لا يَسْمَع؟
dialogue.tr: wa kāna yataʾammalu wa yufakkir: kayfa yaʿbudu l-insānu ḥajarn akhrasa lā yanṭiq, aʿmā lā yubṣir, aṣamma lā yasmaʿ?
dialogue.en: He used to ponder and think: how can a person worship a dumb stone that does not speak, blind and does not see, deaf and does not hear?
dialogue.ur: Woh ghaur-o-fikr karte: insaan aisa pathar kaise poojta hai jo goonga hai bolta nahi, andha hai dekhta nahi, behra hai sunta nahi?

dialogue.ar: فَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّ لِهٰذا الكَوْنِ إِلٰهاً واحِداً هُوَ الرَّبُّ الخالِقُ، وَأَنَّ العَقْلَ لا يَسْجُدُ لِحَجَر.
dialogue.tr: fa-ayqana anna li-hādhā l-kawni ilāhn wāḥidn huwa r-rabbu l-khāliq, wa anna l-ʿaqla lā yasjudu li-ḥajar.
dialogue.en: So he was certain that this universe has one God, who is the Lord and Creator, and that reason does not bow to a stone.
dialogue.ur: To unhein yaqeen ho gaya ke is kainat ka ek hi ilah hai jo Rab aur Khaliq hai, aur ke aql pathar ke samne sajda nahi karti.

dialogue.ar: وَاخْتارَهُ اللهُ رَسولاً، فَقامَ يَدْعو أَهْلَهُ إِلى الإيمانِ بِالحِكْمَةِ وَالصَّبْر.
dialogue.tr: wa khtārahu llāhu rasūln, fa-qāma yadʿū ahlahu ilā l-ʾīmāni bi-l-ḥikmati wa ṣ-ṣabr.
dialogue.en: Allah chose him as a messenger, so he began calling his people to faith with wisdom and patience.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne unhein rasool chuna, to woh apne logon ko hikmat aur sabr ke saath imaan ki dawat dene lage.

dialogue.ar: وَبَدَأَ بِأَقْرَبِ النّاسِ إِلَيْهِ، فَكَلَّمَ أَباهُ بِأَدَبٍ وَقالَ لَهُ: يا أَبَتِ، لِماذا تَعْبُدُ ما لا يَسْمَعُ وَلا يُبْصِر؟
dialogue.tr: wa badaʾa bi-aqrabi n-nāsi ilayh, fa-kallama abāhu bi-adabin wa qāla lah: yā abat, li-mādhā taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu wa lā yubṣir?
dialogue.en: He began with the nearest of people to him; he spoke to his father politely and said: father, why do you worship what neither hears nor sees?
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne sab se qareebi shakhs se shuru kiya aur apne walid se adab se kaha: abba jaan, aap us ki ibadat kyun karte hain jo na sunta hai na dekhta hai?

dialogue.ar: فَغَضِبَ الأَبُ وَسَخِطَ عَلى ابْنِهِ، وَهَدَّدَهُ بِالإِبْعادِ، وَلَمْ يَقْبَلِ النَّصيحَة.
dialogue.tr: fa-ghaḍiba l-abu wa sakhiṭa ʿalā bnih, wa haddadahu bi-l-ibʿād, wa lam yaqbali n-naṣīḥa.
dialogue.en: The father became angry and furious at his son, threatened him with banishment, and did not accept the advice.
dialogue.ur: Walid ghusse mein aa gaye aur bete se naraaz hue, use ghar se nikalne ki dhamki di aur nasihat qubool nahi ki.

dialogue.ar: فَمَضى إِبْراهيمُ في دَعْوَتِهِ وَحَلُمَ عَلى قَوْمِهِ، ثُمَّ فَكَّرَ في طَريقَةٍ يَقْتَنِعونَ بِها بِأَعْيُنِهِم.
dialogue.tr: fa-maḍā ibrāhīmu fī daʿwatihi wa ḥaluma ʿalā qawmih, thumma fa-kkara fī ṭarīqatin yaqtaniʿūna bihā bi-aʿyunihim.
dialogue.en: Ibrahim continued his call and was forbearing with his people, then thought of a way in which they would be convinced with their own eyes.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim apni dawat jari rakhte hue apni qaum par burdbar rahe, phir aisa tareeqa sochne lage jis se woh apni aankhon se qayal ho jayein.

dialogue.ar: وَفي يَوْمٍ خَلا المَكانُ مِنْهُمْ، فَدَخَلَ إِلى مَعْبَدِ الأَصْنامِ وَحَطَّمَها إِلّا أَكْبَرَها.
dialogue.tr: wa fī yawmin khalā l-makānu minhum, fa-dakhala ilā maʿbadi l-aṣnāmi wa ḥaṭṭamahā illā akbarahā.
dialogue.en: One day when the place was empty of them, he entered the temple of the idols and broke them all except the biggest.
dialogue.ur: Ek din jab jagah un se khali thi, woh butkhane mein gaye aur sab but tor diye siwaye sab se bare ke.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا رَجَعوا وَرَأَوْا ما حَدَثَ غَضِبوا وَفَتَّشوا عَمَّنْ فَعَلَ ذٰلِكَ، وَبَحَثوا حَتّى وَصَلوا إِلى إِبْراهيم.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā rajaʿū wa raʾawā mā ḥadatha ghaḍibū wa fattashū ʿamman faʿala dhālik, wa baḥathū ḥattā wa ṣalū ilā ibrāhīm.
dialogue.en: When they returned and saw what had happened they were angry and searched for who did it, and kept looking until they reached Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Jab woh lautay aur jo hua dekha to ghusse mein aaye, kisne kiya yeh dhoondha, aur dhoondte dhoondte Ibrahim tak pohanche.

dialogue.ar: قَالُوا أَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَاسْأَلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا يَنطِقُونَ.
dialogue.tr: qālū: aʾanta fa-ʿalta hdhā bi-ʾālihatinā yā ʾbrāhīm? qāl: bal fa-ʿalahu kabīruhum hdhā fa-sʾalūhum ʾn kānū yanṭiqūn.
dialogue.en: They said: Did you do this to our gods, Ibrahim? He said: Rather, this biggest of them did it; so ask them, if they can speak.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kaha: Ibrahim, kya tum ne hamare mabudon ke saath yeh kiya? Unhon ne kaha: balke is bade ne kiya hai, unse pooch lo agar woh bolte hain.

dialogue.ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ  أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ؟
dialogue.tr: qāla afataʿbudūna min dūni llāhi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayʾn wa lā yaḍurrukum? uffin lakum wa limā taʿbudūna min dūni llāhi afalā taʿqilūn?
dialogue.en: He said: Do you worship besides Allah what neither benefits you at all nor harms you? Shame on you and on what you worship besides Allah. Do you not reason?
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kaha: kya tum Allah ke siwa unki ibadat karte ho jo tumhein na kuch nafa dete hain na nuqsan? Afsos hai tum par aur unpar jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte ho, kya tum aqal nahin rakhte?

dialogue.ar: فَلَمْ يَجِدوا حُجَّةً، فَقَرَّروا أَنْ يُحْرِقوهُ بِالنّارِ، وَجَمَعوا الحَطَبَ وَأَشْعَلوه.
dialogue.tr: fa-lam yajidū ḥujjatan, fa-qarrarū an yuḥriqūhu bi-n-nār, wa jamaʿū l-ḥaṭaba wa ashʿalūh.
dialogue.en: They found no argument, so they decided to burn him with fire, and they gathered wood and lit it.
dialogue.ur: Un ke paas koi daleel na rahi, to unhon ne use aag mein jalane ka faisla kiya, lakdiyan jama kin aur aag bhadkayi.

dialogue.ar: وَرُمِيَ إِبْراهيمُ في النّارِ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالإيمانِ بِرَبِّه.
dialogue.tr: wa rumiya ibrāhīmu fī n-nāri wa qalbuhu muṭmaʾinnun bi-l-ʾīmāni bi-rabbih.
dialogue.en: Ibrahim was thrown into the fire while his heart was at peace with faith in his Lord.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim ko aag mein phenka gaya jab ke un ka dil apne Rab par imaan se mutmain tha.

dialogue.ar: قُلْنَا يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ.
dialogue.tr: qulnā yā nāru kūnī bardn wa salāmn ʿalā ʾbrāhīm.
dialogue.en: We said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Hum ne kaha: aye aag, Ibrahim par thandi aur salamati ban ja.

dialogue.ar: وَجادَلَهُ المَلِكُ النُّمْرودُ، فَقالَ إِبْراهيمُ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ هُوَ الَّذي يُحْيي وَيُميتُ، وَادَّعى الطّاغِيَةُ أَنَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مِثْلَ ذٰلِك.
dialogue.tr: wa jādalahu l-maliku n-numrūd, fa-qāla ibrāhīmu inna rabbahu huwa l-dhī yuḥīī wa yumīt, wa ddaʿā ṭ-ṭāghiyatu annahu yafʿalu mithla dhālik.
dialogue.en: King Namrud argued with him; Ibrahim said that his Lord is the One who gives life and causes death, and the tyrant claimed that he does the same.
dialogue.ur: Badshah Namrud ne un se bahes ki; Ibrahim ne kaha ke un ka Rab wahi hai jo zindagi deta aur maut deta hai, aur zalim ne dawa kiya ke woh bhi aisa hi karta hai.

dialogue.ar: ﴿قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْتِي بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ فَأْتِ بِهَا مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ﴾.
dialogue.tr: «qāla ibrāhīmu fa-inna llāha yaʾtī bi-sh-shamsi mina l-mashriqi fa-ʾti bihā mina l-maghrib.»
dialogue.en: «Ibrahim said: Indeed Allah brings the sun from the east, so bring it from the west.»
dialogue.ur: «Ibrahim ne kaha: beshak Allah suraj ko mashriq se laata hai, to tu use maghrib se le aa.»

dialogue.ar: وَتَذْكُرُ القِصَّةُ أَنَّهُ تَأَمَّلَ الكَوْكَبَ وَالقَمَرَ وَالشَّمْسَ، فَلَمّا غابَتْ كُلُّها عَرَفَ أَنَّ ما يَغيبُ لا يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يَكونَ رَبّاً.
dialogue.tr: wa tadhkuru l-qiṣṣatu annahu taʾammala l-kawkaba wa l-qamara wa sh-shams, fa-lammā ghābat kulluhā ʿarafa anna mā yaghību lā yaṣluḥu an yakūna rabbn.
dialogue.en: The story mentions that he contemplated the star, the moon and the sun, and when all of them set he knew that what disappears cannot be a lord.
dialogue.ur: Qissa batata hai ke unhon ne sitare, chand aur suraj par ghaur kiya, aur jab sab ghaib ho gaye to jaan liya ke jo ghaib ho jaye woh rab nahi ho sakta.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ هاجَرَ مَعَ زَوْجَتِهِ هاجَرَ وَابْنِهِما الصَّغيرِ إِسْماعيلَ، وَتَرَكَهُما بِأَمْرِ اللهِ في وادٍ قُرْبَ مَكَّة.
dialogue.tr: thumma hājara maʿa zawjatihi hājara wa bnihimā ṣ-ṣaghīri ismāʿīl, wa tarakahumā bi-amri llāhi fī wādin qurba makka.
dialogue.en: Then he migrated with his wife Hajar and their little son Ismail, and left them by Allah's command in a valley near Makkah.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh apni biwi Hajra aur apne chhote bete Ismail ke saath hijrat kar gaye, aur Allah ke hukm se unhein Makkah ke qareeb ek wadi mein chhor diya.

dialogue.ar: وَرَكَضَتِ الأُمُّ بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ تَبْحَثُ عَنِ الماءِ، فَأَنْبَعَ اللهُ لَهُما بِئْرَ زَمْزَمَ، وَاجْتَمَعَ النّاسُ حَوْلَها.
dialogue.tr: wa rakaḍati l-ummu bayna ṣ-ṣafā wa l-marwati tabḥathu ʿani l-māʾ, fa-anbaʿa llāhu lahumā biʾra zamzam, wa jtamaʿa n-nāsu ḥawlahā.
dialogue.en: The mother ran between Safa and Marwa looking for water, so Allah made the well of Zamzam gush forth for them, and people gathered around it.
dialogue.ur: Maa Safa aur Marwa ke beech paani dhoondti hui dauri, to Allah ne un ke liye Zamzam ka kuan jari kar diya, aur log us ke gird jama hue.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا كَبِرَ إِسْماعيلُ بَنى مَعَ أَبيهِ الكَعْبَةَ بِأَمْرِ اللهِ، وَهِيَ أَوَّلُ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: wa lammā kabira ismāʿīlu banā maʿa abīhi l-kaʿbata bi-amri llāh, wa hiya awwalu baytin wuḍiʿa li-n-nās.
dialogue.en: When Ismail grew up he built the Kaaba with his father by Allah's command, and it is the first house set up for people.
dialogue.ur: Jab Ismail bade hue to unhon ne Allah ke hukm se apne walid ke saath Kaaba tameer kiya, aur woh logon ke liye rakha gaya pehla ghar hai.

q.en: What did Ibrahim's people worship?
q.ur: Ibrahim ki qaum kis ki ibadat karti thi?

q.en: Why did Ibrahim not worship the idols?
q.ur: Ibrahim ne butoun ki ibadat kyun nahin ki?

options: He knew Allah is One and the idols are only stones
His friends told him not to
options_ar: لِأَنَّهُ عَلِمَ أَنَّ اللهَ واحِدٌ وَأَنَّ الأَصْنامَ حِجارَةٌ

q.en: What did Allah say to the fire?
q.ur: Allah ne aag se kya kaha?

options: Be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim

q.en: What is the opposite of «المَشْرِق» (the east)?
q.ur: «المَشْرِق» ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: Which well appeared near Makkah, where people gathered?
q.ur: Makkah ke qareeb kaun sa kunwan zahir hua jahan log jama hue?
q.ar: أَيُّ بِئْرٍ ظَهَرَتْ قُرْبَ مَكَّةَ وَاجْتَمَعَ النّاسُ حَوْلَها؟
